## The Best Hair and Beauty Stocking Stuffers


Stocking stuffers are a holiday classic. If you’re having trouble finding the perfect mini gifts, look no further than OLAPLEX®. Discover holiday kits, hair masks, and more beauty and haircare stocking stuffers that will delight your friends and family this holiday season.


## Hair Mask Stocking Stuffers


In the winter, hair is prone to dryness and frizz, making a hair mask the perfect gift. This holiday, consider gifting the[Weightless Nourishing Mask](https://olaplex.com/collections/treat/products/olaplex-weightless-nourishing-mask-200ml) or the[Rich Hydration Mask](https://olaplex.com/collections/treat/products/olaplex-rich-hydration-mask-200ml) . Each of these hair masks is 200ml, making them the perfect size for your bestie’s stocking. Give the Weightless Nourishing Mask to someone with fine to medium hair. This mask:


- Offers lightweight hydration through 5 washes*
- Gives instant volume that lasts all day
- Reduces and prevents breakage even after 5 washes


For medium to coarse hair, give the Rich Hydration Mask. This mask:


- Offers instant hydration that lasts through 5 washes**
- Strengthens hair and prevents breakage even after 5 washes
- Creates shine and all-day, humidity-resistant frizz control

[Total Hair Repair Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-total-hair-repair-set) has everything you need for stronger, softer, visibly healthier hair. This OLAPLEX holiday set includes:


- [OLAPLEX Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment](https://olaplex.com/collections/treat/products/olaplex-n-3plus-complete-repair-treatment-100ml) prewash to strengthen hair
- [Nº.4 Bond Maintenance™ Strengthening Shampoo](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n4-bond-maintenance-strengthening-shampoo-250ml) , which is the perfect holiday shampoo to strengthen and hydrate hair
- [Nº.5 Bond Maintenance™](https://olaplex.com/products/olaplex-n-5-bond-maintenance-conditioner-us)[Strengthening](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n5-bond-maintenance-strengthening-conditioner-250ml)[Conditioner](https://olaplex.com/collections/wash/products/olaplex-n5-bond-maintenance-strengthening-conditioner-250ml) to smooth and strengthen hair


### The Strength & Shine Set

### Iconic Stylers Set


Who doesn’t love shiny hair? The[Iconic Stylers Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-iconic-stylers-set) contains two key products for shinier, smoother hair and heat protection:

- An exclusive keychain to keep your glow within reach

[The Hydration Heroes Set](https://olaplex.com/collections/value-sets/products/olaplex-hydration-heroes-set) is the perfect way to give your loved ones hydrated, healthy-looking hair with every wash. This healthy hair set contains:

## More Stocking-Stuffer Sized OLAPLEX Haircare Products


Some full-sized OLAPLEX products will make the perfect stocking stuffers. For example,[OLAPLEX Nº.7 Bonding Oil™](https://olaplex.com/collections/styling/products/olaplex-n-7-bonding-oil-30ml) is small enough to throw in your purse for touch-ups throughout the day. This styling hair oil doesn’t just boost shine and color vibrancy to hair—it also tames frizz and flyaways. Another stocking stuffer option is[Nº.3PLUS Complete Repair Treatment](https://olaplex.com/collections/treat/products/olaplex-n-3plus-complete-repair-treatment-100ml) . This pre-wash treatment repairs and strengthens all hair types for healthy hair inside and out. Using OLAPLEX Patented Bond Technology, Nº.3PLUS begins working in just 3 minutes, repairing all 3 broken bonds and restoring healthy, resilient hair.
